name: London Luton Airport

runway.quote: Work on the 2.16km runway commenced each night at 00:01 and completed by 05:45

hours.quote: LLA holds a 24 hour licence to operate and there is no ban on night flights.

curfew.v: no ban on night flights, but older-generation jets are not allowed at night and night noise limits and a quota count system apply
curfew.none_quote: LLA holds a 24 hour licence to operate and there is no ban on night flights.
curfew.quote: we prohibit the operation of older generation jets at night.

noise.v: night flights are controlled through lower noise violation limits, movement limits and a quota count system
noise.quote: Each specific aircraft type is assigned Quota points based on how noisy it is.

slots.v: a fully coordinated (Level 3) airport, so slots are allocated by the UK slot coordinator
slots.context: Listed by ACL among UK Level 3 (coordinated) airports; ACL Luton page: 'London Luton Airport was formally declared as Level 3 effective Summer 2013.'

handling.v: business aviation handled by Signature Flight Support (two sites) and Harrods Aviation
handling.quote: Harrods Aviation is the leading London-based business aviation service provider.

notes: UK AIP could not be read. 'none': true for curfew means only that the operator states there is no ban on night flights; night restrictions (older jets banned, quota count, 79 dB(A) night noise limit) still apply, so do not write 'no restrictions'. The night period hours were not found on a readable page. ACL pages do not say explicitly that business aviation needs slots, only that Luton is Level 3. Handling company names: the website rule says the site names no companies except authorities, airport operators and cited sources, so these are for internal use.
